Absolute worktree paths (/tmp/r87-*) survive only as history: one LOG.md line and tracked .ufo/waves/round-87 receipts. Neither is a gate, a fixture, or executable; no live checker reads them.

Because zero live surfaces reference the r87 worktrees, metadata-pruning the 19 prunable r87 registrations in lore-shokunin breaks no gate, fixture, or documented reproduction path. This corroborates seat-01's SAFE(metadata-prune) ticket for /tmp/r87-B1 and extends it to the whole r87 set.
